name: The Grey Dream
source:
[i]After working in several small-time jobs and graduating from university, you got offered a semi-decent job in an international trading company. Meanwhile, life throws many opportunities down your way, it is up to you to decide. It's time for you to wake up from the dream and face the world's facts.[/i]

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/thegreys]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
[i]在做过几份小工作并大学毕业后，你在一家国际贸易公司找到了一份还算体面的工作。与此同时，生活给你带来了很多机会，这取决于你自己的决定。你是时候从梦中醒来，面对世界的事实了。[/i]

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/thegreys]Patreon[/url]]
